notes.title: Release Notes 1.2.4
notes.notes:
The number of completed entrustments has been added to the game.
The number of completed entrustments the achievement "Nandemoya" has been completed should be based on the number of times displayed in-game.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.notes:
Fix steam achievements
Best Treatment Method and Legendary Assassin can finish in Normal Level.

Some battle crash bug.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.notes:
Enhancement: Reduced level difficulty
Enhancement: Added end-of-battle options
Fixed: Fixed an issue where "Plunder" was not available

notes.title: Better and better!!! "Nandemoya of Flower Street" Demo version update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43623618/f47c9c2e209e1e5a14abd10821ca723f7239c59a.png[/img]
[h1]Optimization project:[/h1]
We work hard to make the game better, just want to give you the best gaming experience
Hope you like it!

[olist]
[*]Interface optimization
[*]Newbie teaching optimization
[*]Add auto-battle function
[*]Add Kanban girl function
[*]Remove assassination system
[/olist]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43623618/9cdba23032c0cf9f00a9142a60787808c540fe79.png[/img]
Please add to the wish list!

[h1]battle[/h1]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43623618/41f5e896e44fb17f07a2ab6818cb3dc798ce1b04.png[/img]

In view of the player's response that the operation of the battle is  a little inconvenient, so recently for the battle operation, especially the way to switch skills to make adjustments

As shown above, just click on the skill name and the three skills you are carrying will pop up for you to choose

[h1]New Kanban girl function[/h1]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43623618/5b545d895e7697535865323a10beff2cc99b6e05.png[/img]
If you have downloaded the new DEMO version of the gentleman should be able to see the Kanban girl function, in addition to the Kanban girl  role can be switched, the background can also be switched, click on the Kanban girl  will also have a voice, hope you like!

[h1]New language[/h1]
Russian is currently added to the game, and other languages are expected to be added one after another, but since the team is relatively small, the addition of new languages can only be done slowly, so please forgive me!

[h1]Introduction[/h1]
You are an assassin with extraordinary skills. live in seclusion in an inconspicuous mansion on Flower Street and work in the Nandemoya. Your life is actually pretty good by yourself, but the little sister next door comes to visit you all day long. You are a legendary assassin, you originally dismissed the girl's request, but...so big! This little sister's breasts are really big!

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
Freely create your own fighting style, find the right target on the busy street and knock it down. As long as you complete the girl's commission, you can get the intimate reward you are eager for.

[h3]Game Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Dynamic CG
[*]Rich storyline
[*]Female characters with different personalities
[*]Matching Skills
[*]Exciting strategic battles
[*]Some Japanese dubbing
[/list]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43623618/55fa9b6a4b3ce4037dddc4116efc1806e61f06e9.png[/img]
